summary.text: Michael J. Webert is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 61st District, which covers part of Culpeper County, part of Fauquier County and Rappahannock County, and has served since 2012.
Webert sits on the House committees on Rules; Public Safety; Labor and Commerce; and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: Michael J. Webert was born in Denver, Colorado, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Webert's education as Kent School (1998) and George Mason University (B.A., Communication, 2010).
The profile gives Webert's occupation as farmer.

Webert's listed memberships and affiliations include Fauquier County Farm Bureau (board member); Fauquier Livestock Exchange (board member); John Marshall Soil and Water Conservation District Board (associate director); Virginia Forage and Grassland Council (former vice president); Warrenton Rugby Football Club (former president); Virginia Angus Association.
